schemaVersion.description: Bump only when the generator makes a breaking change to this shape.

remoteUser.description: Default: vscode (the non-root user baked into the base image).

remoteEnv.description: Passthrough to devcontainer.json's remoteEnv. Values can reference the container's own environment, e.g. { "PATH": "${containerEnv:PATH}:/some/dir" }.

dockerfileBuild.description: Configuration that only affects the generated Dockerfile (build time) -- none of this appears in devcontainer.json.

toolchains.description: Built-in, security-reviewed install recipes -- reference a version, not raw apt/curl steps.

pnpm.description: Enforces pnpm over npm: installs a pinned pnpm version at build time (templates/install-pnpm.sh) and blocks npm install/ci/i/add shell-wide (templates/npm-guard.sh). Requires dockerfileBuild.toolchains.node. Both scripts and the postCreateCommand sourcing line are wired automatically -- no separate dockerfileBuild.files[] entry needed.

npmrcPath.description: Path to a project-supplied .npmrc with 'registry=' (required) and optionally 'min-release-age=' (days; install-pnpm.sh defaults to 0 -- latest published version -- if absent). ./foo or ../foo = relative to this answers file. Anything else = relative to the submodule root. COPY'd into the image as /root/.npmrc at build time and read by install-pnpm.sh -- this file is project-specific and must never live in this generator repo.

aptPackages.description: Plain 'apt-get install' packages that need no special repo setup.

sourcePath.description: ./foo or ../foo = relative to this answers file. Anything else = relative to the submodule root (e.g. templates/npm-guard.sh).

targetPath.description: Absolute path inside the image, e.g. /etc/profile.d/npm-guard.sh

source.description: Relative to the workspace root on the host; the mount source is workspaceFolder/source.

readonly.description: Whether the bind mount is read-only.

blockedRegistryHosts.description: Hostnames to null-route (both 0.0.0.0 and [::1] forms are generated automatically). Merged with blockedRegistryHostsFile, if set.

blockedRegistryHostsFile.description: Path to a newline-delimited hostname list (# comments and blank lines ignored). ./foo or ../foo = relative to this answers file. Anything else = relative to the submodule root, e.g. examples/blockedRegistryHosts.txt. Merged with blockedRegistryHosts, deduped.

extraHosts.description: Literal --add-host entries, e.g. { "host.docker.internal": "host-gateway" }. Not for null-routing -- use blockedRegistryHosts for that.

customizations.description: Merged on top of the baseline vscode settings/extensions. Arrays are concatenated+deduped, objects replace the baseline key they collide with.

features.description: Passthrough for devcontainer Features unrelated to Node/Java (those are handled by dockerfileBuild.toolchains). Default: {}

devcontainerExtra.description: Escape hatch: merged last, verbatim, into the generated devcontainer.json. Use sparingly.
